$comment: Operis agent team. Applied by `npm run agents:setup`. Tool names: built-ins (board_read, send_to_agent, view_image, email.send, ...) and our MCP tools as operis.<tool>. Default is deny: each agent only gets what is listed.

ops.name: operis-ops
ops.description: Finds and dispatches a human worker for each job.

schedules.input: Check jobs stuck in outreach for 15+ minutes with no accept and follow the worker-sourcing skill's 'If nobody accepts' steps.

ops.$comment: Approved by Andrew (services/outreach/docs/NAIVE.md): skill worker-sourcing@2; find_people allow; send_blast allow (fully autonomous; real sends gated server-side by OUTREACH_LIVE / OUTREACH_TEST_ALLOWLIST). Re-blast schedule is created disabled; enable once live.

verifier.name: operis-verifier
verifier.description: Checks worker proof against the job and approves or escalates.

finance.name: operis-finance
finance.description: Captures customer payments, pays workers, handles refunds, keeps the ledger.

sales.name: operis-sales
sales.description: Markets Operis to people building AI agents (hand-sourced prospects, guarded email) and answers people who write in.

schedules.input: Run a marketing round: follow 'Each scheduled round' in your instructions.

sales.$comment: services/growth (docs/specs/2026-11-08-sales-recruiter-design.md): cold email only through operis.send_marketing, which enforces GROWTH_LIVE / OUTREACH_TEST_ALLOWLIST, opt-outs, caps and the unsubscribe link in code. email.send is for replies only and always waits for a founder (approvals.ts HUMAN_ONLY). Schedule created disabled; enable once live.

recruiter.name: operis-recruiter
recruiter.description: Grows the pre-vetted worker pool: finds people for the job families in demand and invites them to join and verify their ID.

schedules.input: Run a recruiting round: follow 'Each scheduled round' in your instructions.

recruiter.$comment: services/growth: recruit_search (Monid spend capped in code: $0.50/call, $2/day; no ContactOut) and recruit_invite (guarded like send_marketing). No email.send, SMS or DMs. Schedule created disabled; enable once live.

disputes.name: operis-disputes
disputes.description: Settles complaints, failed jobs, no-shows and Stripe chargebacks on the evidence, inside the money limits.

compliance.name: operis-compliance
compliance.description: Decides for each funded job whether Operis holds the liability, only connects, or refuses, under the liability policy.
compliance.$comment: Cameron, docs/specs/2026-11-08-liability-model-design.md. Woken on held (contracts/states.ts WAKE_ON_ENTER). Create with npm run agents:setup after the PR merges, then set NAIVE_AGENT_COMPLIANCE on Vercel.

ceo.name: operis-ceo
ceo.description: Coordinates the Operis team: plans every job on the board, assigns members, owns P&L and the daily report.
